observation_summary: An IllegalFieldValueException is thrown when parsing a valid leap day (February 29) in specific timezones because the parser incorrectly assumes a non-leap year.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs when parsing a date (like February 29th) into a MutableDateTime object that is offset from UTC. The original code calculated the 'defaultYear' for the parser using the local time (instantMillis + offset), which could shift the date into a different year depending on the timezone's offset from UTC. If the offset caused the date to shift into a non-leap year, the parser would incorrectly validate 'February 29' against a non-leap year's constraints, throwing an IllegalFieldValueException. The fix correctly calculates the default year based on the UTC instant rather than the local time, ensuring the leap year status is evaluated consistently regardless of the timezone.
